verdict.comment: The filly GALILEO DAME would have had realisitc hopes in the Triumph and yet she runs here armed with her useful age allowance.

comments.airofentitlement: Maiden hurdle win came over 2m4f but assured stamina has proved key before in this race
comments.auroravega: 6-9 under rules; workmanlike in a Grade 3 last time but can no doubt improve further
comments.bluey: A front-runner who will be prominent to a point but probably not where it matters
comments.brendasasking: Only 1-9 over hurdles and limitations were ruthlessly exposed at this level two months ago
comments.discodancer: Dual winning hurdler but now exposed and she's very much up against it
comments.divaluna: Hurdling career has yet really to take off but her good bumper form brings her into this
comments.galileodame: 4yo filly who is getting a weight allowance and would have had a fair shout in the Triumph
comments.hollygrovechacha: Recent Grade 2 winner but even so she probably has no more than place aspirations
comments.janeeire: Form is down the pecking order in this company and she's been off since early November
comments.jubileealpha: Has won her last two without much fuss and trainer rates her chances in this higher grade
comments.justarose: Unexposed dual winner but probably speaks volumes that Harry Cobden prefers Jubilee Alpha
comments.karamoja: Entitled to win her latest maiden but not this on any of her form
comments.karolinebanbou: It was a winnable maiden that she won at Fairyhouse but she's going the right way
comments.kimidemai: Triple bumper winner in France but was 16l behind Sixandahalf at Fairyhouse
comments.kittyfoyle: Useful winning hurdler but Jubilee Alpha has her number on their previous clashes
comments.lagertha: Won easily at Chepstow last time but unlikely to be following up in this company
comments.magicmccolgan: Won her maiden at Punchestown despite jumping markedly left at the last two flights
comments.maughreen: Held in high regard by her top team and unextended to win her bumper/maiden; now hooded
comments.metkayina: Capable mare but it's hard to envisage her making an impact at this level
comments.mysticalgoddess: Beaten about 10l in her two Grade 3s, latterly behind Aurora Vega; opposable
comments.queeniestclair: Only 1-18 on the Flat and no closer than 16l in four races over hurdles; out of her depth
comments.sixandahalf: Progressive last year on the Flat and did everything right in winning her maiden hurdle
comments.tourovalie: Multiple winner but she makes very limited appeal on this promotion to Graded level
comments.venusienne: Runner-up in sole French start; this asks a huge question of her after so long out

races.raceComment: tourovalie is marginally preferred with a score of 56.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over hollygrovechacha. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 5/17 at cheltenham. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments and improving, though step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.asianmaster: Fourth in the Supreme here last year; potentially ahead of his mark; interesting contender
comments.caldwellpotter: Gets into this handicap off an attractive mark; Grade 1 hurdle winner for previous stable
comments.deecapo: Should be suited by this drop back in distance but doesn't look favourably treated
comments.densworth: Less consistent than stablemate Pic Roc; had further wind surgery since last run
comments.esperfecto: In-form 10yo but the stats are against him (no horse older than nine has won this race)
comments.firefox: Smart, consistent and has several pieces of Grade 1 form (hurdles/fences); major player
comments.insurrection: Won well last time but this is a harder task and Harry Cobden sides with Caldwell Potter
comments.lordofthunder: Two solid performances since wearing a tongue-tie; beat Pic Roc at Newbury latest
comments.moondorange: Successful under Sean Bowen in an open handicap over C&D last time, showing grit; solid
comments.nurburgring: Fourth in the Triumph 12 months ago; has a very attractive chase mark; shortlisted
comments.omoorepark: Managed to complete last time; final-fence faller in his other two chase runs; not solid
comments.picroc: Ran well behind Lord Of Thunder at Newbury; threatening to regain the winning thread
comments.ryansrocket: All rules wins at 2m; failed to get home in soft-ground event over C&D last time
comments.sansalvador: Grade 3 winner; useful but record suggests a safe round of jumping is not guaranteed
comments.shanballykid: Third in the 2024 Coral Cup; unconvincing form over fences this term; revival needed
comments.springwellbay: Highly progressive; impressive in an open handicap over C&D on New Year's Day; big player
comments.theothermozzie: Scored over 2m last time; lacks consistency and has something to prove back at 2m4f
comments.whatsupdarling: Lacks progression and is out of the winning habit (on a nine-race losing sequence)

races.raceComment: insurrection is marginally preferred with a score of 59.8%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over lordofthunder. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 3 wins from 8 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 4/11 at cheltenham. Key attributes include positive comments and improving, though step up in class need consideration.

comments.catchhimderry: Won Exeter qualifier (good to soft); 6lb higher today but overall he's been progressive
comments.dartdart: Late headway at Navan (2m6f) and close call at Carlisle (upped to 3m1f, soft); progressive
comments.doddiethegreat: Back-to-form 2nd at Haydock (upped to 3m) with cheekpieces; now tongue tied as well
comments.feetofadancer: Good 3rd of 20 at Leopardstown (2m7f, yielding) latest; respected stable won this in 2021
comments.guardthemoon: Progressive before he showed worryingly little on soft going last time after 12 weeks off
comments.harbourlake: Never better than when last seen (November) but he is also on a career-high mark
comments.henrithesecond: Stormed well clear at Sandown (heavy); 2nd there latest; question if he's not in the mud
comments.idem: Good, staying-on fourth in the Musselburgh qualifier (3m, good to soft) on latest outing
comments.jaifroid: 12yo returning from 315 days off when 33-1 winner at Chepstow (3m, soft) 19 days ago
comments.jerikodureponet: Some renewed promise from off the pace on last two outings; wears headgear first time
comments.karldestourelles: Promising youngster who looks set to resume improvement on today's step back up in trip
comments.luckylyreen: Best form in big-field handicaps on testing ground over 3m/2m7f on his last two outings
comments.maximacgold: Rather inconsistent but 4th and 2nd in big-field handicaps on two of his last three starts
comments.onebigbang: Career best to win at Haydock (3m1f) latest from Doddiethegreat and he did it quite tidily
comments.pattermerchant: Two 4ths and a 5th when sent handicapping (3m/2m7f last twice); should retain potential
comments.shanaghbob: 2nd at Huntingdon (3m1f, soft); headgear returns and he may have more to offer as a stayer
comments.supersurvivor: Impressively resurgent to win at Doncaster and Huntingdon; back to almost career-high mark
comments.supremegift: Won at Market Rasen in November; different headgear after out of form both runs since
comments.thomasmor: 650 days off before tidy win at Wincanton (3m1f); chase debut one month later wasn't great
comments.willthewise: Won handicap debut in a right slog for 19-runner Naas qualifier (2m7f, heavy) 18 days ago
comments.winsomelosesome: Firmly on upward curve; won with more authority than bare result in Leopardstown qualifier
comments.zainnights: C&D winner; back to form at Huntingdon (soft) latest but he now needs to hit a new level

verdict.comment: Preference is for LUCKY PLACE, who has thrived this season and could have even more to offer tackling 3m for the first time.

comments.bobolinger: Twice second to Home By The Lee this season; the return to Cheltenham could be a plus
comments.buddyone: Fourth in this last year; not at his best this season, predominantly over fences
comments.crambo: Two-time winner of the Grade 1 Long Walk; yet to shine at Cheltenham in two visits
comments.franciscanrock: Third to Rocky's Diamond in Grade 2 at Gowran Park last time; would be a surprise winner
comments.galaw: Has done very well in handicap chases here at about 2m4f; doubts about hurdles and trip
comments.gowelroad: Won Grade 2 Cleeve Hurdle over C&D last time but has something to find in this company
comments.homebythelee: Grade 1 win last time; can give a good account but has come up short in this in the past
comments.langerdan: Tends to come alive at the Cheltenham Festival; intriguing contender now back up to 3m
comments.luckyplace: Two Grade 2 wins this season and open to further improvement now up in trip; respected
comments.monmiral: Won last year's Pertemps Final Handicap over C&D but looks up against it today
comments.mysticalpower: Last year's Supreme runner-up; dam second in this; extremely lacklustre the last twice
comments.nemeanlion: Has something to find but he's clearly thriving and could be suited by the step up in trip
comments.rockysdiamond: Grade 2 winner last time; only five and very lightly raced but needs sizeable step forward
comments.teahupoo: Won this in good style 12 months ago and will be tough to beat if repeating that form
comments.thewallpark: 3m handicap win here in October; steady pace against him in the Long Walk; one to consider

races.raceComment: gowelroad is marginally preferred with a score of 64.2%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more progressive and more reliable profile over teahupoo. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include excellent form and strong course form and positive comments and improving, though returning from absence and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Little between Masaccio and JAGWAR on their recent run here but the latter looked to find life quite easy that day and is preferred.

comments.anpeanndearg: Much improved in 2m1f chases this winter; right up weights; not ruled out back up in trip
comments.conflated: Finished 3rd in the Gold Cup and Ryanair at last 2 Festivals; way below form this winter
comments.demnat: Won yard debut over 2m4f last spring; looks to have a stiff task from out of weights
comments.fugitif: At his best here and good second in 2023 running; losing run goes back to late 2023
comments.gemirande: Improved wins at Ascot and over C&D; 6lb higher than for the latter; yard won this 3 times
comments.ginnysdestiny: Powerful front-runner; two C&D wins last winter; slow start to season; potential reviver
comments.ilridoto: Some sterling efforts on both courses here but beaten about 9l in last 2 runnings
comments.individualiste: Improvement over fences before Christmas; well held latest; 9lb out of weights
comments.jagwar: In a nice rhythm round here when convincing over C&D latest; up 7lb but still improving
comments.jordans: Made good progress over fences for new yard; should be suited by this test; handicap debut
comments.lamalmason: C&D winner in late 2023 on sole course start; better than ever of late; high in weights
comments.marsharper: Losing run goes back to September 2023 and had shortcomings in this race last year
comments.masaccio: Solid 2m4f form since chasing, including in well-contested C&D handicap latest
comments.pathdoroux: Close 3rd in 2m Grand Annual last March; never raced beyond 2m2f under rules
comments.personalambition: Grade 2-winning hurdler; maiden over fences but has potential; yard won this in 2024
comments.riaan: Pulled up in both Festival runs, including this race last year, so has a track query
comments.seddon: Won the Plate in 2023; not in such good form now; probably needs more weight off his back
comments.shakemuparry: Good 3rd in this two years ago and came out best last March; now just 2lb higher
comments.tahmuras: Talented but has run to his best only once this season and pulled up at Kempton recently
comments.thecompanysergeant: Has course form; creditable hurdle debut for new yard in January; of interest back chasing

races.raceComment: jagwar is marginally preferred with a score of 56.3%, holding clear edges in more progressive over pathdoroux. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Excellent course form of 4/10 at cheltenham. Key attributes include strong course form and positive comments and improving, though step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Having narrowly hit the front when falling at the final fence at Doncaster in January, WALKING ON AIR can make amends today.

comments.cleatuspoolaw: Improvement needed but lightly raced and top Irish yard has good record in this race
comments.dailypresent: Well-beaten fifth in this last season but this 8yo could be stronger now one year on
comments.domofmary: Went very close in Sussex National last month but has faded on both visits here
comments.fantasticlady: Grade 2 win against males last April; current mark may be beyond her in competitive race
comments.galopdechasse: Below par the last twice and there are doubts about both his stamina and his current form
comments.gelinobello: Promising novice in late 2022 but lightly raced since and pulled up at Sandown last month
comments.gitmaker: Below best on both runs this term but second in this last year; contender if back on song
comments.grozni: Won over hurdles in December but soundly beaten in this last year and others appeal more
comments.johnnywho: Hasn't kicked on from chase debut win at Carlisle but no surprise if things click today
comments.manothepeople: C&D winner; ran well in the Edinburgh National when failing to stay; might not be far away
comments.midnightourfred: Good form here last term and better than ever in Ireland this season; solid claims
comments.mintboy: Mixed form in this novice chase campaign but the extra emphasis on stamina could be ideal
comments.musicoftara: Two good runs since joining the yard but the step back up in trip may be a negative
comments.ninegraces: Travelled well and found plenty at Punchestown; new trip could unlock further improvement
comments.nowwhereorwhen: Won at Down Royal in January but this 10yo could be vulnerable in this much hotter race
comments.patsfancy: 10yo; on a reduced mark but well beaten at Sandown last month when back from latest layoff
comments.samajeste: 2-4 over fences this term (small-field races); only a 7yo and he's from top Irish yard
comments.sinenomine: Won the hunter chase here 12 months ago and this test of stamina is right up her street
comments.walkingonair: Narrowly ahead when falling at final fence at Doncaster; remains well treated back up 4lb
comments.westerninthepark: Boxed on well behind progressive winner over extended 2m6f last time; this trip may suit
comments.weveallbeencaught: Easy win at Doncaster in January but only fifth back there 12 days ago after 8lb rise
comments.whereitallbegan: Inconsistency & jumping are worries but looked big threat in Welsh National before blunder
comments.wiseguy: Stayed on well over 3m at Ascot last month and today's extra yardage could be a plus
comments.yeahman: Creditable third of 18 in the Troytown at Navan in November and he's not ruled out

races.raceComment: sinenomine is confidently preferred with a score of 66.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more progressive and more reliable profile over gitmaker. Won 3 of last 3 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 8 wins from 15 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 9/17 at cheltenham. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and strong course form and improving.

comments.croaghpatrick: Won at Carlisle but well below par both runs since; this course winner has it to prove
comments.gibberwell: Pulled up at Wetherby 15 days ago; this C&D winner needs to take a big step forward
comments.goodoldbill: Pulled up on his last three outings, retried over hurdles at Newcastle on last occasion
comments.hermesboy: Has offered little in two runs over fences this term, pulled up at Carlisle 24 days ago
comments.iseethesea: Blinkered when easily scoring at Wincanton week ago; escapes penalty; the one to beat
comments.muroor: Winless since 2020; cheekpieces are tried for his new yard with plenty to prove
comments.raceviewroad: Cheekpieces on when a below-par fifth at Carlisle latest; the sort to get back on track
comments.returnfire: C&D winner; respectable sixth at Musselburgh latest; much respected after a break
comments.theskiffleking: Off 14 months before pulled up at Southwell for his new yard latest; blinkers reached for
comments.torosay: C&D winner but well held when unseating rider last at Carlisle latest; sort to bounce back
comments.wotsmyname: Is 0-20 and he was pulled up in Ayr handicap chase 17 days ago; hard to make a case for

comments.arcticambition: On a long losing run and he comes here out of sorts over both hurdles and fences
comments.atlanticexpress: Not discredited when third at Catterick 24 days ago; one for the shortlist back up in trip
comments.clovisboy: Course winner but he's offered little in four runs this season; visor is reached for now
comments.dequall: Course scorer but has been well below par on last two outings over C&D and at Sedgefield
comments.idealderomay: Last of six in 2m4f Ayr novice hurdle 17 days ago; he's 12lb out of the handicap too
comments.jeminem: Pulled up after bad early mistake at Musselburgh latest; can't be discounted back hurdling
comments.kautodamour: It's now 13 starts since his last victory but not disgraced when third at Wetherby latest
comments.kilmorerock: Off four months before fair Newcastle sixth latest; longer trip could suit; possibilities
comments.reagrovelord: Still to get his head in front but in decent order; not ruled out off 2lb lower
comments.starvantage: Remains winless but he comes here in very good order; bold showing is on the cards
comments.tartancookie: Rusty after 18 months off when pulled up over C&D 9 months ago; faces another absence now
comments.thebigbreac: On hat-trick after scoring twice at Wetherby (3m); up 6lb but more to offer; major player
comments.uokhun: Yet to win but she arrives in good nick; very much one to consider up in trip
comments.vengaboy: Off 14 months before beating one for new yard at Newcastle in January; lots more needed
comments.zwicky: Good runner-up at Sedgefield last month; can make his presence felt once more

verdict.comment: So Quiet has the ability to win a race of this nature but so does SWISS ACE and he edges preference.

comments.abruzzomia: Conditions to suit but needs to bounce back from a lacklustre run at Southwell last month
comments.brazilianrose: Having a good year but she needs to bounce back from a lesser Lingfield run two weeks ago
comments.kitgabriel: 8.6f win in December; fair run next time; cheekpieces return but he's up in class
comments.meresidemadness: C&D win last month followed by two solid placed efforts; up in class but should run well
comments.mrbaloo: Three fine runs, with and without headgear, this year; in the shake up once more
comments.outrunthestorm: C&D winner last year but he hasn't shone in two runs this time around
comments.soquiet: Still seeking a first handicap win and proving most frustrating; sure to be popular again
comments.starliner: C&D winner in November off 2lb lower; mixed since but capable on a good day
comments.swissace: Three-time C&D winner; on a dangerous mark and had an excuse (draw) latest; contender
comments.vibrato: Three wins in late 2024, including C&D; struggled more recently but down in weights

races.raceComment: meresidemadness is marginally preferred with a score of 57.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over abruzzomia. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 8 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Castan is thriving but the returning pair Zarzyni and ALLIGATOR ALLEY could have his measure this time.

comments.alligatoralley: He's been much better than this level in his day and an intriguing runner on stable debut
comments.castan: 3-3 since cheekpieces were added; 2lb rise for latest win looks fair; high on the list
comments.darkkestrel: Capable off this mark but likely he'll need them to go too hard early if he's to win
comments.herakles: Effective over C&D but absent since a low-key run in November; others look stronger
comments.kingscrown: Ready C&D win 12 days ago  but that was a small-field Class 6; this demands much more
comments.monksdream: Runner-up here the last twice; 1lb well in and he should remain competitive
comments.ourabsentfriends: Only seventh behind Castan here two weeks ago; 4lb better off but others make more appeal
comments.zarzyni: Talented but hard to win with; can go well fresh so each-way claims back from 5 months off

races.raceComment: castan is marginally preferred with a score of 59.4%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions over kingscrown. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 5 wins from 12 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Nothing went right for JUST TYPICAL last time and he can confirm earlier C&D dominance over Pop Favorite and Odd Socks Havana.

comments.concertboy: Course regular who's enjoying a consistent year; this mark should be within range
comments.evoluir: Done a lot of his racing in sprints; stamina to prove going beyond 7f for the first time
comments.justtypical: Everything went wrong at Wolverhampton latest and is better than that; one to consider
comments.madeall: Has often not seen it out over this longer trip and is some way down the pecking order
comments.mrjetman: Plenty of short-priced defeats to go with his sole win; bit to prove for another new yard
comments.oddsockshavana: Back to form when beaten a neck over C&D last Tuesday; holds obvious claims
comments.pinjarra: Regressive but isn't without hope if first-time headgear helps stepping back up from 7f
comments.popfavorite: Often misses the break and will always need races to pan out his way; remains capable
comments.yorkshireglory: Better expected up to 1m2f here when last seen six months ago; too soon to write him off

verdict.comment: Southbank has decent claims of a fourth C&D win but ROMAN EMPEROR is on a workable mark again and preferred.

comments.dionbaker: Wins have come under aggressive rides over 7f; another ordinary effort over C&D last time
comments.justtenhigh: Progressed well since handicapping in headgear but is 4lb higher than when last winning
comments.kodired: Lost his way since a C&D win off a 2lb higher mark last autumn; others look stronger
comments.romanemperor: Lost his way last year but is back on a workable mark; one of the more interesting runners
comments.southbank: Currently 3-5 over C&D and been running consistently off this sort of mark; shortlisted
comments.thismydream: Infrequent winner; pulled hard last time and is some way down the pecking order

races.raceComment: justtenhigh is marginally preferred with a score of 57.6%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over southbank. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 4/14 at chelmsford. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The mare STELLA HOGAN comes into this in hot form and is taken to follow up her remarkable victory here on Saturday.

comments.coolree: 0-9 on the AW and will need to be near best returning from six months off for new trainer
comments.driftsaway: 4-8 on the AW and bids for a hat-trick; shortlisted off a 6lb higher mark
comments.kracking: Still 5lb above last winning mark and hasn't been getting home in his races lately
comments.poeticforce: 2lb lower than when twice second at Wolverhampton late last year, but losing run up to 21
comments.starpupil: Course winner over 7f, but  still to truly convince over this far
comments.stellahogan: In fine form since hood went on (1221); every chance of going in again under her penalty
comments.timetobenice: 0-10 in handicaps and only seventh of 12 at Southwell on Tuesday; needs to better that

races.raceComment: driftsaway is marginally preferred with a score of 57.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over stellahogan. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 4/11 at chelmsford. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
